episode_summary: In this episode, Ben Lalez discusses the critical importance of consistent client communication and how it can prevent lost deals. The conversation also explores the role of AI in real estate, emphasizing that while AI can enhance efficiency, it cannot replace the human touch. The episode provides actionable insights for agents to improve their follow-up practices and leverage technology effectively.
